youtube_description:
Hi Lovely people, in this episode you will see us struggling in the tough Austrian Winter. We were forced to put on tire Snow Chains due to an unnecessary sliding on a hill with our Expedition Vehicle. We also filmed a bit of the final touches on our new 4x4 Truck at KRUG EXPEDITION in Schladming, Austria. Our motorcycle back rack is finally on! 
Enjoy this video and find out where we are heading next...
See ya when we see ya!
Fabian, Isabela and Matheo.
